map.head: MAP
map.panel: The map will go here: pick a section, show lines, set destinations.

options.head: OPTIONS
options.panel: The settings will go here, sorted by area.

world.head: WORLD
world.panel: The world's settings will go here: weather, time of day, traffic.

vehicle.head: VEHICLE
vehicle.panel: The vehicle's settings will go here.
vehicle.hint: Point at an action to see what it does.

hof.name: Depot file (HOF)
hof.desc: Change the current depot file (used for the timetable)

number.name: Fleet number
number.desc: Change the vehicle's current fleet number

switch.name: Drive the next vehicle
switch.desc: Take the wheel of another vehicle standing in the world

place.name: Place a vehicle
place.desc: Place a vehicle of your choice

swap.name: Swap for another vehicle
swap.desc: Put another vehicle in this one's place and drive it

couple.name: Couple
couple.desc: Couple the vehicle to the one in front of or behind it

clearplaced.name: Remove the placed vehicles
clearplaced.desc: Removes all vehicles you've placed from the world

refuel.name: Refuel
refuel.desc: Fills the tank of the current vehicle

reset_vehicle.name: Put back on its wheels
reset_vehicle.desc: Return the vehicle to an upright position

reload.name: Reload this vehicle
reload.desc: Read the vehicle's files again (.bus, model and sound configuration, scripts) and drive it from here

getout.name: Get up and out
getout.desc: Step out of your car and explore the world

teleport.name: Move on the map
teleport.desc: Teleports you to any location on the map

tplist.name: Teleport to a start point
tplist.desc: Teleport to a starting point on the map
